description: The bar chart illustrates the performance ratios of three language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the ratio in percentage, ranging from 50% to 90%, with horizontal gridlines at 10% intervals. For the Movies category, Llama3 achieves a ratio of approximately 90%, Qwen2 reaches about 90%, and ChatGPT attains around 73%. In the Songs category, Llama3 scores roughly 84%, Qwen2 reaches approximately 90%, and ChatGPT achieves about 62%. For the Basketball category, Llama3 achieves a ratio of approximately 67%, Qwen2 reaches about 57%, and ChatGPT attains around 61%. The bars are grouped by category along the horizontal axis, with each model represented by a distinct color as indicated in the legend. Across all categories, Qwen2 consistently shows the highest performance, particularly in Songs, while Llama3 performs well in Movies and Songs, and ChatGPT shows the lowest performance in the Basketball category.
